# aidd

> AIDD is a method for delivering software with AI agents: agents do the work, and a person makes four decisions: the plan, Spec approval, the release, and the launch. aidd is the toolkit that runs it: a zero-dependency Python CLI and gate, a self-contained agent skill, Claude Code plugins, and an optional delivery team of agent roles. Every change runs one loop, always on: Plan (for work bigger than one change), Specify, Spec approval, Implement and Verify, Review, Merge approval, Ship, and Learn. The guard checks each step an agent takes; the gate checks each change before it merges, and the `aidd/gate` status reports its decision. The gate starts in advisory mode and blocks nothing until `mode: enforce` is set in the base branch's config and the platform requires the status.

Install it in a project by following the runbook, or ask a coding agent to: "Install thaithienvanid/aidd and apply it to this project."

## Concepts

- Outer loop and inner loop: the person runs the outer loop (the decisions), and the team runs the inner loop (the work). The loops belong to the change: each role takes only its own steps, and a big goal holds its Specs' loops.
- Lead and change order: the lead (the session that runs the team) takes the team's decisions on evidence, never an approval. A change to an approved Spec is a change order (`aidd revise`), whoever asks for it.
- Four decisions: D1 the plan, D2 Spec approval, D3 the release (the Merge approval), D4 the launch. Only a person makes them; a standing approval (`approve all`) covers D2 and D3, never D1 or D4.
- Big goal and small goal: an ask bigger than one Spec is a big goal (an Initiative) of small goals (Epics), each two weeks or less.
- Ships: how a small goal reaches users. `incremental` (the default): each Spec merges by itself. `flagged`: each Spec merges behind a flag that stays off until the launch. `batched`: the Specs collect on a goal branch, released once.
- Goal branch: `goal/<EPIC>`, for a small goal that ships batched. Only `aidd integrate` (a Spec's branch into the goal) and `aidd sync` move it.
- Ship it: the person's typed `ship it`, a standing approval for one change. It covers the head they saw, and a later fix while the Spec and its tests stay as approved. Each approval names it, and it ends when the change lands.
- Launch: the Merge approval of a flagged Epic's `launch` Spec, which turns the feature on for users. Always the person's.
- Trunk-based flow: the default branch is the one trunk, with few branches, each short-lived (`gates.max_branch_days`, `max_open_branches`, `max_goal_days`).
- Explore branch: `explore/<topic>`, free work that never merges as it is. The guard allows every edit there, the gate fails any change from it, and only a person starts one.
- Guard and gate: the guard is the hook inside the agent; the gate is `aidd gate` and the `aidd/gate` status in CI. What each checks follows the branch (docs/METHOD.md, Checks by branch).

## Install

- [llms-install.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thaithienvanid/aidd/main/llms-install.md): the step-by-step runbook for coding agents (install the CLI, `aidd init`, `aidd doctor`, commit, hand back)
- [docs/INSTALL.md](https://github.com/thaithienvanid/aidd/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md): every install path, per coding agent, and how to remove it
- [docs/QUICKSTART.md](https://github.com/thaithienvanid/aidd/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md): the first Spec through the gate, and branch protection

## Use

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/thaithienvanid/aidd/blob/main/AGENTS.md): what an agent reads first in a repository that uses aidd
- [.agents/skills/aidd/SKILL.md](https://github.com/thaithienvanid/aidd/blob/main/.agents/skills/aidd/SKILL.md): the skill: ask the gate for the route (aidd gate --paths) before the first edit, specify, implement and verify in scope, stop for humans
- [docs/HOW-TO.md](https://github.com/thaithienvanid/aidd/blob/main/docs/HOW-TO.md): short answers to common tasks: a big goal, a goal branch, an explore branch, and `aidd list`
- [docs/CLI.md](https://github.com/thaithienvanid/aidd/blob/main/docs/CLI.md): every command and flag
- [docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md](https://github.com/thaithienvanid/aidd/blob/main/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): symptom, cause, and fix for what goes wrong most often
- [docs/TEAM.md](https://github.com/thaithienvanid/aidd/blob/main/docs/TEAM.md): the delivery team: roles, packs, practice skills, handoffs, cost
- [docs/TEAM-REFERENCE.md](https://github.com/thaithienvanid/aidd/blob/main/docs/TEAM-REFERENCE.md): the team's reference tables: standards per role, practice skills, extensions, life cycle coverage, model tiers
